description: Rewrite PnlGraph3D to support toggleable timeframes (1M daily, 1W hourly, 5m, 1m) with toggle buttons, passing all data sources from StockDetail.
steps: Rewrite PnlGraph3D to accept all data sources as props (history, intraday, fiveMin, minute)
Add toggle buttons (1M, 1W, 5m, 1m) using the same chart-toggle CSS as the spread chart
Default to 1W (hourly) mode for better granularity on recent trades
For 1M mode use daily OI history with per-point OI; for intraday modes use latest daily OI as constant
Show 'Not enough data for this timeframe' if selected mode has < 2 points but keep toggle visible
Update StockDetail to pass intraday, fiveMin, and minute props to PnlGraph3D
acceptance_criteria: PnlGraph3D accepts history, intraday, fiveMin, minute props
Toggle buttons rendered in chart-toggle div with active class styling
1M mode uses daily close + OI from history.futures
Intraday modes (1W, 5m, 1m) use constant OI from latest daily history
Shows message when < 2 data points but toggles remain visible
StockDetail passes all data sources to PnlGraph3D
findings: Build passes cleanly. The 3D canvas rendering logic is preserved in a separate Graph3DCanvas subcomponent for clarity.
